notes.title: Major Update: 0.13.2
notes.notes: Updates to the Story and gameplay.

notes.title: Pre-Alpha 0.11.1
notes.notes:
-Limit break meter now says the name of the ability and changes color to match the type
-Growbots only have one limit break ability based on their main type instead of getting both
-Limit break is now activated by clicking on the bar instead of being represented as a move
-Particle effects when growbots switch into battle
-Fixed some status effects that weren't working properly
-Added more crystals to cave
-Replaced bush model with new bush model
-Added healing machine to center platform
-Fixed item names not displaying
-Fixed error when using incubator before gathering any scans
-Incubator can now be leveled up
-DNA can be collected after a battle
-Popup explaining status effects when hovered over
-Switching growbots in battle now requires you to select a growbot and then press a Switch button, so you can look at the descriptions for its moves if you want to without having to switch to it first
-Party is now healed after being defeated
-Bug fixes etc

notes.title: Pre-Alpha 0.9
notes.notes:
- Bug Fixes and Battle System Updates.

- Added Team Battles

notes.title: New Growbot Design
notes.notes:
Over the next few days, we will be adding in a new Growbot Design. Post your ideas here or on our website for a chance for it to be the name of the creature in game! 

Our Website: https://growbotsrpg.wordpress.com/2020/10/30/help-us-name-this-growbot/

notes.title: Now On Steam
notes.notes: We are happy to announce that we will be launching exclusively on Steam and Itch. We are working hard on updates and will have a working build for you all to playtest soon.
